## 维护者速读

- **要做：** 选项用标签显示，去掉标签旁的机器键。
- **完成标准：** 这四个表单上不再出现原始值。

Filing gate **③ a task the maintainer set**: the maintainer's ruling on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194, recorded there at `6354968262` (the director seat, posting from the maintainer's account): 「25251 B hotcrm B」, 2026-10-23T01:05:47Z. That is letter B for all three rounds, exactly as the seat recommended, and it adopts **T2-U03**. Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 1 (`os-elon-musk`, session `session_014xanhPEmGTMTfVH4UokwJT`) under objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194's *After the ruling*. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Grade:** triage's. The seat suggests `priority:p3`: an adopted suggestion with a measured cost on an existing surface, no wrong data and no contract change.

**Reader (who acts):** objectstack triage routes and grades it. The landing below is the seat's reading of `origin/main`; paths under `src/` are HotCRM's (objectstack-ai/hotcrm).

## Governing text

- The ruling above. Per objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194's own governing text, this item is an adopted suggestion through filing gate ②, not a defect card, and a platform or console landing is changed there, never re-implemented in HotCRM: 「平台相关的功能，应该尽量先改平台。」 (maintainer, 2026-10-18, ledger `6245607810`).

## Why (measured)

- **Pages / persona:** Business Units, Sharing Rules, Packages, Datasources; the system administrator.
- **Now:** raw option values: Kind `cost_center`, Recipient Type `business_unit` / `unit_and_subordinates`, label `autoMigrate`, and labels followed by their machine key ("Display name\* name").
- **Cost:** the help text under Recipient Type already uses labels the options do not show.
- **Evidence:** objectstack-ai/hotcrm [track 2 report, *UI and UX suggestions*](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/REPORT.md), U-03; [`09-people-business-units-new.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/09-people-business-units-new.png), [`15-access-sharing-rules-new.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/15-access-sharing-rules-new.png), [`02-apps-packages-new-invalid-id.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/02-apps-packages-new-invalid-id.png). Re-measured unchanged on `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0 by the round 2 pass ([round 2 track 2 report, *UI and UX suggestions*](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/4d7cc467dcb08226fea5b8a1b2ea89ee05d6353b/qa/2026-10-20-v18-setup/REPORT.md), the section's opening paragraph).

## Landing

- The tester's reading: `packages/platform-objects` select options (labels missing or equal to the value), or the console form rendering the value beside the label (objectui).
- The dev measures which per form: an option declared with no label is fixed at the declaration; a label rendered with its key is the console's, and that half goes to objectui.

## Done when

- Business Units, Sharing Rules, Packages and Datasources show option labels only, and no field label is followed by its machine key.
- Labels are translated with the object's other labels; a pin per declaration fixed.

**Size:** S.

Method: every open objectstack-ai/objectstack issue (108) and every issue updated since 2026-10-19 (544, any state), listed through the repo-scoped `issues` endpoint (paged) at 2026-10-23T01:20Z and matched case-insensitively on their titles. Words: `option label`, `machine key`, `raw option`, `cost_center`, `recipient type`. 0 hits. **New.**
